items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I don’t remember that. I’m thinking of another one.

ctx.x: With Jukkis, right? And Anders Jormin.
No, this is with Tim Hagens, Sonny Heinila, a Finnish tenor player, Jarmo on piano, of course, and Ron McClure and Billy Hart.
I don’t remember that. I’m thinking of another one.
